task: Cuenta en 90–110 palabras un viaje en el que algo salió mal. Usa el pasado simple, el pasado continuo y al menos un past perfect (had + participio).
paragraphs: We were driving across the desert in Nevada when the warning light came on. My friend Carla looked at the map on her phone, but there was no signal. The last petrol station we had passed was sixty miles behind us, and the sun was already going down.

A few minutes later, we saw a sign: Rhyolite. Behind it there were the ruins of a town: a bank without a roof, an empty railway station and a strange house made of thousands of glass bottles. We decided to stop there and wait for a passing car.

Later we learned the town's story. In 1904, gold was found in the hills nearby, and in just a few years Rhyolite grew into a busy town of several thousand people, with shops, hotels, a hospital and even an opera house. But the gold ran out quickly, a financial crisis hit, and by 1920 almost everyone had left.

That night, nobody passed. We sat in the car and ate the only food we had: a packet of crisps and two apples. The silence was incredible. Every time the wind moved a piece of metal, Carla jumped. "It's just the wind," I said, although I wasn't completely sure myself.

At around midnight, we saw lights moving among the ruins. My heart was beating fast. Then we heard voices speaking in German. It was a group of photographers who had come to take pictures of the stars. They laughed when we told them we had thought they were ghosts, and in the morning they lent us enough petrol to reach the next town.
I have travelled a lot since then, but that night under the desert sky is still my favourite travel story.
